vehicles.name: Rustbucket
vehicles.description: Twenty-year-old sedan held together by primer and prayer. Cheap to lose.

vehicles.name: Pipsqueak
vehicles.description: Two-seat city bubble. Parks anywhere, loses every fight.

vehicles.name: Hopper
vehicles.description: Hot-hatch on a budget. Zippy, light and easy to throw around.

vehicles.name: Meridian
vehicles.description: The commuter car every city is full of. Does everything okay.

vehicles.name: Regent
vehicles.description: Executive saloon. Soft, heavy and quietly fast.

vehicles.name: Tradewind
vehicles.description: Wood-panelled family wagon. Five seats and a roof rack.

vehicles.name: Boulevard
vehicles.description: Candy paint, wire wheels and whitewalls. Wallows like a waterbed.

vehicles.name: Swamp King
vehicles.description: Box-body donk on 26-inch gold rims. Turns like a parade float.

vehicles.name: Bubble
vehicles.description: Rounded 90s land yacht on chrome 24s. Candy paint mandatory.

vehicles.name: Thunderhorse
vehicles.description: Classic fastback with twin stripes. Loud, light and tail-happy.

vehicles.name: Vandal
vehicles.description: Supercharged street brawler. Blower through the hood, grip optional.

vehicles.name: Marauder
vehicles.description: Four-door muscle sedan. Seats the crew and still smokes the tyres.

vehicles.name: Kestrel GT
vehicles.description: Rear-engined GT with a ducktail. Precise and planted.

vehicles.name: Vortex
vehicles.description: Mid-engined wedge. The fastest thing in Palm County with plates.

vehicles.name: Cabana
vehicles.description: Two-seat drop-top roadster for A1A cruising.

vehicles.name: Everglade
vehicles.description: Three-row luxury SUV. Big, safe and thirsty.

vehicles.name: Palmetto
vehicles.description: Doorless open-top 4x4 with a roll cage. Built for the Glades.

vehicles.name: Workhorse
vehicles.description: Full-size work pickup with a bench seat for three.

vehicles.name: Mudcat
vehicles.description: Lifted swamp truck on mud tyres. Climbs anything, corners like a fridge.

vehicles.name: Tradesman
vehicles.description: Panel van with a ladder rack. Every contractor in the county drives one.

vehicles.name: Strongbox
vehicles.description: Armoured cash-in-transit truck. Only obtainable through the heist.

vehicles.name: Palm County Cruiser
vehicles.description: Standard sheriff's patrol car. Stealing one gets noticed.

vehicles.name: Interceptor
vehicles.description: Pursuit-spec police SUV. Fast, heavy and hard to shake.

vehicles.name: Bulwark SWAT
vehicles.description: Armoured SWAT truck. Rams through roadblocks; seats a full team.

vehicles.name: Medic Unit
vehicles.description: Box ambulance. Carries a full med kit and a defibrillator.

vehicles.name: Engine 9
vehicles.description: Ladder engine with tandem rear axle. Six crew, one very long turning circle.

vehicles.name: Sunshine Cab
vehicles.description: The city's yellow taxi. Drive a fare, earn a fare.

vehicles.name: Metro Transit
vehicles.description: Low-floor city bus. Twenty-four seats, zero acceleration.

vehicles.name: Haulmaster
vehicles.description: Box truck. Slow and wide, with a lot of room in the back.

vehicles.name: Hook & Haul
vehicles.description: Wrecker with a boom and wheel-lift. Hooks up whatever you park badly.

vehicles.name: Compactor
vehicles.description: Rear-loader garbage truck. The heaviest thing on the lot.

vehicles.name: Razorback
vehicles.description: Superbike. Fastest launch in the game; one bump and you're off.

vehicles.name: Zippy
vehicles.description: 49cc scooter with a basket. Slow, cheap and weaves through traffic.

vehicles.name: Gladesrunner
vehicles.description: Everglades airboat on its trailer. Display only until the game has water.
